exports.name: Spotlight
exports.description:
One contextual hint beside a target: a new feature, a setup nudge. It is
informational, so it does not take focus or block the page. Escape (unless
the person is typing elsewhere) or the dismiss button closes it. If the target is
not on screen, nothing renders.

props.name: action
props.description: An extra button, e.g. "Add a provider".

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Default "Got it".

props.name: highlight
props.description: Ring the target. Default true.

props.description: An extra button, e.g. "Add a provider".

exports.name: Tour
exports.description:
A guided sequence of anchored steps. It is non-modal: the page stays
usable and outside clicks do not end it. Focus moves into each step,
Escape ends the tour (unless the person is typing in a field or editor
outside it), and focus returns to where it was when the tour started.
The app owns the copy, the eligibility rules and what it persists.

props.name: dim
props.description: Dim the page outside the target. Default true.

props.name: fallbackFocus
props.description: Where focus goes if the element that started the tour is gone.

props.name: missingTarget
props.description: `center` (default) shows a step whose target never appears in the middle; `skip` moves past it.

props.name: onEnd
props.description: The tour is over. Store dismissal or completion yourself, keyed by tour id and revision.

props.name: step
props.description: Controlled, zero-based.

props.name: waitMs
props.description: How long to wait for a late target. Default 2000ms.

props.name: prepare
props.description:
Reveal what the step points at (open a panel, switch a route) before it
shows. Aborted if the person leaves the step first; a rejection shows the
step centred rather than stranding the tour.

props.name: target
props.description: Omit for a centred step with no anchor.

exports.description: The same marker as TourAnchor, for elements you render yourself.

exports.name: TourTarget
exports.description:
A registered target id (see TourAnchor), or a function returning the
element. Ids are stable; never target generated class names or nth-child.

exports.name: waitForTourTarget
exports.description:
Resolves when the target is mounted and visible, or with null after
`timeoutMs` or when `signal` aborts. Handles targets that render late
(lazy panels, async data) without polling forever.
signatures: (target: TourTarget | undefined, timeoutMs: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<Element | null>
